title: A core's Part History gets its own status entry with the same note
custom_preconds: Admin. Active part P with a core.
custom_steps:
1. Bulk deactivate P with note "Superseded by RC-500X"
  2. Open /parts/history/{core id}
custom_expected:
1. P is inactive
  2. Core has its own "Deactivated | Reason: Superseded by RC-500X" entry
